P.text: Owner attempts to unregister a vault via unregisterVault; the function checks that the vault has no balance (balanceOf > 0 causes revert).
P.evidence_quote: When unregistering a vault there are some checks made in the function before the function can finish executing- one of those checks is that the transaction will rvert if the vault has any balance i.e `balanceOf > 0`.

I.text: The vault balance must be zero for unregisterVault to succeed.
I.evidence_quote: one of those checks is that the transaction will rvert if the vault has any balance i.e `balanceOf > 0`.

V.text: A malicious user front-runs the owner's unregisterVault transaction by directly transferring a dust amount of asset to the vault, making its balance non-zero and causing a denial of service so the owner cannot remove the vault.
V.evidence_quote: A malicious user can exploit this by front running the owner's tx of `unregisterVault` by directly transferring dust amount of asset to the vault which will make the balance of the contract non zero resulting in DoS
